title: AWS Conﬁg 现支持 77 种新的资源类型
summary: AWS Conﬁg 现已支持 77 种新增的 AWS 资源类型，涵盖的关键服务包括 Amazon EC2、Amazon S3 Files 和 Amazon Q Business。此次扩展为您的 AWS 环境提供了更大的覆盖范围，使您能够更有效地发现、评测、审计和修复更广泛的资源。 此次发布后，如果您为所有资源类型启用了记录功能，则 AWS Config 将自动跟踪这些新增资源。新支持的资源类型也可在 Config 规则和 Config 聚合器中找到。 您现在可以使用 AWS Conﬁg 在所有提供资源的 AWS 区域 监控以下新增的受支持资源类型： 资源类型： AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget AWS::GuardDuty::ThreatEntitySet AWS::PCS::Queue AWS::ApplicationSignals::Discovery AWS::GuardDuty::TrustedEntitySet AWS::QBusiness::DataSource AWS::APS::AnomalyDetector AWS::HealthLake::DataTransformationProfile AWS::QBusiness::Index AWS::APS::ResourcePolicy AWS::InspectorV2::CodeSecurityScanConfiguration AWS::QBusiness::Permission AWS::ARCRegionSwitch::Plan AWS::IoT::Logging AWS::QBusiness::Plugin AWS::Batch::QuotaShare AWS::IoTWireless::WirelessDeviceImportTask AWS::QBusiness::Retriever AWS::Batch::ServiceEnvironment AWS::LicenseManager::Grant AWS::QBusiness::WebExperience AWS::BedrockAgentCore::PaymentConnector AWS::LicenseManager::License AWS::QuickSight::OAuthClientApplication AWS::BedrockAgentCore::ResourcePolicy AWS::Lightsail::DatabaseSnapshot AWS::RTBFabric::InboundExternalLink AWS::Braket::SpendingLimit AWS::MediaConnect::RouterInput AWS::RTBFabric::RequesterGateway AWS::CleanRooms::IdMappingTable AWS::MediaConnect::RouterNetworkInterface AWS::S3Files::AccessPoint AWS::CleanRoomsML::ConfiguredModelAlgorithm AWS::MediaLive::Multiplex AWS::S3Files::FileSystem AWS::CloudWatch::AlarmMuteRule AWS::MediaLive::Node AWS::S3Files::FileSystemPolicy AWS::Connect::UserHierarchyStructure AWS::MediaLive::SdiSource AWS::S3Files::MountTarget AWS::ConnectCamp
